newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek Aeolian Invest H1 net up 393.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Greek Aeolian Invest H1 net up 393.4 pct.

text.p: Greek closed-end trust Aeolian Invest said its half-year net profit jumped 393.4 percent to 758 million drachmas from 154 million in the year-ago period.
Gains from portfolio transactions grew 442 percent year-on-year to 792 million drachmas in the first half of 1997 whereas portfolio income dropped 20 percent to 51 million drachmas.
As of June 30, 1997 the fund had unrealised gains of 331 million drachmas and its Net Asset Value (NAV) per share stood at 1,283 drachmas. Its shares traded at a 18.9 percent discount.

The fund raised its allocation of assets in Greek equities from 68.7 percent at end-1996 to 82.5 percent in June, expanding its positions in bank, cement, telecommunications, passenger shipping stocks and cash instruments.
Over the same period, positions in Greek fixed-income securities, metallurgical, food & beverage, construction, small-caps and foreign stocks were reduced.

"Aeolian Invest is expected to keep up its heavy allocation in Greek listings in 1997. The management anticipates the improvement in macroeconomic indicators and corporate results to continue and the fund is invested to this extent in Greek equities," it said.
